question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Some were very shaky and unstable, others were _______, and a few were both!
solution:
The correct answer is "**convoluted**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, it is given that the objects or situations were a both unstable as well as shaky and difficult.
 
• **Now, the blank will contain an adjective that will indicate the nature of the subject.**
 
• **Among the given options, the most appropriate word to fill in the blank is "convoluted."**
 
 
• The word "convoluted" means intricate, complex or twisted.(जटिल)
 
 
• ​Example: We must notice the convoluted rope work.
 
 
 
 
 
• ​It is the most appropriate word to describe objects or situations that are complex and difficult to understand.
 
• The other options do not fit the context of the sentence and have different meanings.

​Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1) voluted means twisted or coiled in a spiral shape. (विशेष भूषा या अंलकार विभुषित)
 
• Option 2) diluted means made weaker or less concentrated.(जलमिश्रित)
 
• Option 4) involuted means folded or curved inwards.(उलझा हुआ)
